title: Lanes in the KRN repository skip the red-first and clause arms
body:
Source: operator 2026-11-15: keep red-first for outside lanes, drop it for lanes in the KRN repository (memory no-gates-just-code, 2026-11-07).
Why: lanes in this repository write a dozen `Clause N: not reproducible` lines per PR to satisfy the test-first and clause arms (t-4kqzdw0, t-bxw0ben, t-8tvfrbs, t-781d08h reports), the ceremony no-gates removed; the arm's value is unmeasured (Fable 1115k: test-first did not beat K).
Outcome: the KRN repository's own contract opts out of the test-first and acceptance-clause Stop arms (repo-level switch in krn.json, not an env var lanes can forget); adopted repositories keep them on by default.
Files: krn.json or src/repo/contract.ts, src/hook/stop.ts, docs/program/lead-rules.md if it names the clause ceremony
Proof: a lane run in this repository ends without clause lines; an outside row still prints red-first 1.
Predicted: proof stop-refusals <= 0
